name: Daily collection, crawl and contract

steps.name: Run collectors
steps.does: Pull orders, sessions, spend, flows, tickets, reviews and competitor snapshots for yesterday. Stamp each pull.
steps.check: every connector either landed rows or marked its fields unavailable

steps.name: Crawl and diff the site
steps.does: Crawl key pages by script. Diff products, prices, stock, policies, claims and scripts against the last snapshot.
steps.check: every change has a page URL and a before and after value

steps.name: Tier new claims
steps.does: Any claim seen for the first time is matched to the tiers. Unmatched claims become founder questions.
steps.check: no claim marked approved without a founder decision

steps.name: Detect conflicts
steps.does: Compare document facts, interview answers and site facts. Site wins by default; raise the rest.
steps.check: each conflict quotes both sources with dates
steps.ask_founder_if: a conflict blocks a running item

steps.name: Compute the contract
steps.does: Recompute every metric contract field in code. Windows end on yesterday. Missing stays unavailable.
steps.output: contract values with windows and freshness
steps.check: no field is 0 where inputs were missing

steps.name: Brain health note
steps.does: Write freshness and confidence per section and the list of unavailable fields with the source that would fix each.
steps.output: brain health JSON for the Today screen
steps.check: every unavailable field names a connector

qa: every fact has a source and a date
no section claims high confidence with an unavailable input
read_point: none; this is the data step

name: Find the break
human_role: business analyst running the morning numbers

steps.name: Compute deltas and stake
steps.does: In code: current vs own trailing median vs peer band per pipeline stage, and money at stake per stage.
steps.check: every row has a window ending on a full day

steps.name: Rank the breaks
steps.does: Sort stages by stake, tie-break by confidence then upstream position. Unreadable stages listed separately.
steps.check: an unreadable stage is never marked healthy

steps.name: Write the proof
steps.does: For the top 3 breaks, the numbers, the window, what changed and since when. No fix words.
steps.check: every number quoted is in the delta table
steps.ask_founder_if: two breaks tie and the numbers cannot settle it

steps.name: Founder line
steps.does: One sentence naming the break, one on why it is first, one on the next in line.
steps.check: reading level under grade 10

name: Build the top 10 for a break
trigger: scheduled daily after DIAG-W01, or on demand for a chosen break
human_role: head of growth prioritising the week

steps.name: Audit the surface
steps.does: Dispatch the surface auditor for this break. Speed: the lab on 3 pages. Conversion: funnel pages and checkout. Retention: flows and order gaps. Paid: structure and results.
steps.check: every condition has evidence a person can verify
steps.ask_founder_if: the audit needs an access grant

steps.name: Filter the bank
steps.does: In code: ideas by bottleneck and store tags, minus exclusions with a live reason.
steps.check: no excluded idea present

steps.name: Match signals
steps.does: Batches of 40: does each idea's signal fire on the observed conditions, with the quote.
steps.check: every fired idea quotes a condition

steps.name: Web pass
steps.does: Verify time-sensitive claims and search for tactics the bank lacks, within the budget. New candidates to the candidates file.
steps.output: facts and candidates with URL and date
steps.check: budget not exceeded; every fact dated

steps.name: Fill evidence fields and rank
steps.does: Reach from the contract, effect basis from the record or source, brand prior from the registry, effort, cost, risk, dependencies, founder weight. Then the code sort.
steps.check: source carries no weight

steps.name: Challenge the top 15
steps.does: Re-check each against the audit. Demote weak signals and overstated effects with a one-line reason. Promote stronger audit or web ideas.
steps.check: every change from the code sort is written down

steps.name: Write the cards
steps.does: Top 10 as plain-English cards with metric, read point, stop rule, owner specialist and workflow id from the routing table.
steps.check: every card names an observed condition and a read point

qa: no card crosses a red line or a live exclusion
effect sizes from the record or a dated source only
read_point: per card, at its read point

name: Take a read
trigger: event: a registry entry reaches its read point
inputs_required: the entry with metric, window, kill and scale rule

steps.name: Read the metric
steps.does: Pull the metric for the entry's window. Early or unavailable is recorded as such, never as a result.
steps.check: window matches the rule

steps.name: Compare to the rule
steps.does: In code: up, down, flat, or unreadable against the kill and scale rule.
steps.check: no result without a full window

steps.name: Write the learning
steps.does: One plain sentence with the number. Update the brand's prior for the idea. If agency-run and not opted out, update the overlay with direction and tags only.
steps.output: learning line, prior update, overlay row
steps.check: overlay carries no brand identity

steps.name: Notify
steps.does: Tell the Orchestrator so the Today screen and the weekly review pick it up.

name: Gate an artefact
trigger: event: a card, artefact or report is ready

steps.name: Claims
steps.does: Every factual sentence traced to an approved or site-backed claim. Forbidden fails.
steps.check: every fact sentence has a verdict
steps.ask_founder_if: an untiered claim would matter to a customer

steps.name: Numbers
steps.does: Recompute every number from the contract or record in code. Windows on full days. Ratios from totals.
steps.check: no number outside the record

steps.name: Writes, placeholders, competitor text, voice, reading level, red lines, completeness
steps.does: Run the remaining checks in order. Return every failing line with what is wrong and the fix.
steps.check: failures name the line

steps.name: Skill audit
steps.does: Does the artefact match the skill it claims to have followed. Mismatches are warnings for the skill owner.

qa: the gate never edits; it returns

name: Onboard a brand through Door B
trigger: event: new brand added with a website

steps.name: Read the site
steps.does: Run BRN-W01 steps 2 and 3 for the first time: full crawl, snapshot, claims tiered as site-backed, first speed run.
steps.output: brand record v0, first speed measurement
steps.check: products, policies and claims each have a page source

steps.name: Connect sources
steps.does: Present the connector list. For each granted source run the collector and compute the contract fields it enables.
steps.check: ungranted sources show as unavailable with a connect card
steps.ask_founder_if: a source needs a grant only the founder can give

steps.name: Ingest documents and notes
steps.does: Extract facts with sources from Drive, Notion and uploads. Raise conflicts with the site.
steps.check: a summary is not a fact

steps.name: Interview rounds
steps.does: Ask what data cannot answer: margins, what was tried, competitors as the founder sees them, red lines, real policies. Store answers as decisions.
steps.check: no question the brain can already answer
steps.ask_founder_if: always; this step is the founder

steps.name: First break and top 10
steps.does: Run DIAG-W01 and PROP-W01 on what is readable. Show the Today screen with unavailable stages named.
steps.check: every unavailable stage names its connector

steps.name: Team and rooms
steps.does: Invite people to rooms per the approval chain. Build queues.
steps.check: money, writes and red lines stay with the founder unless handed over in writing

read_point: 28 days: brain health and first reads
typical_duration: 1 day of agent time spread over the founder's answers
